required_facts_checked: The Exasol workshop needed access for 50 to 60 participants.
Exasol Personal runs in a participant's AWS account.
The author wanted GitHub Codespaces and did not want to distribute AWS keys.
EC2 instance profiles use STS and temporary credentials.
AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_FULL_URI points SDKs to a credential endpoint.
A Lambda assumes a role and returns temporary credentials.
The Lambda and workshop template use a separate sandbox account and dev container.
A public endpoint receives a secret check shared offline.
aws-sandbox-cli grants agent access in a separate sandbox for about an hour.
phone-aws-gate uses fingerprint authentication and a 15-minute window.
The production database incident led to keeping agents away from production.
unsupported_claims_removed: Removed any implication that the endpoint alone makes permissions safe.
substantive_edits: Rewrote the account as a chronological first-person explanation of the workshop problem and solution.
Connected the credential endpoint to the later agent sandbox and phone gate uses.
Kept the disposable workshop secret and production boundary qualified.
